qualifier: enzymatic route through protoporphyrinogen IX to heme A and B
name: Heme biosynthesis through protoporphyrinogen IX to heme A/B
rationale: All members are steps of or summaries of heme biosynthesis; unlike confusables it lacks iron-sulfur assembly, tetrapyrrole regulation and erythroid differentiation, containing only the biosynthetic route itself.

qualifier: de novo purine and pyrimidine
name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: Members are de novo synthesis of IMP/AMP/GMP/XMP and pyrimidine UMP/UDP/UTP, distinguishing it from confusables built on nucleotide catabolism, NUDT hydrolysis and purine salvage.

qualifier: control of appetite and organism growth
name: Leptin signaling in appetite and body growth control
rationale: Members are leptin signaling plus regulation of appetite, food response and organism growth; confusables instead carry growth hormone/prolactin receptor signaling or feeding behavior and ghrelin.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
qualifier: Wnt and BMP signaling
name: Wnt/BMP-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members cover mesenchymal stem cell proliferation/differentiation with Wnt and a BMP-SMAD mesenchymal module, whereas confusables are committed osteoblast, bone and tendon development.

qualifier: notochord/floor plate midline and spinal motor and interneuron fates
name: Axial midline-driven ventral spinal cord neuron patterning
rationale: Members link notochord/axial mesoderm and floor plate development to dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron/interneuron specification, unlike confusables centred on neural plate borders, hindbrain HOX, convergent extension or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

qualifier: sleep-wake states and mating, parental, aggressive behavior
name: Sleep-wake states and innate mating, parental, aggressive behavior
rationale: Members are sleep/wake regulation, orexin receptor binding and innate social/reproductive and drinking behaviors, while confusables add opioid/neuropeptide G-protein signaling or feeding and locomotor rhythm.

qualifier: tRNA modification and 3'-end processing
name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification
rationale: All members concern processing and modification of mitochondrial tRNAs, distinguishing it from confusables on mitochondrial mRNA/rRNA, mitoribosome assembly and cytosolic tRNA aminoacylation.

core: Viral protein maturation and host targeting
qualifier: nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV PDZ/signaling hijack
name: Viral nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV host-pathway targeting
rationale: Members are coronavirus and hRSV nucleoprotein/protein maturation plus SARS-CoV targeting of host PDZ junction proteins and signaling, unlike confusables with spike/E/3a maturation, nuclear transport or bacterial entry.

qualifier: chaperone/CCT folding with UPR, heat shock and integrated stress response
name: Chaperone folding and unfolded-protein, heat-shock, integrated stress responses
rationale: Members span ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, HSF1 heat shock, GCN2/HRI translational stress, mitochondrial UPR and chaperonin folding, whereas confusables emphasize ER targeting/ERAD, FOXO death signaling or stress granules.

qualifier: E3 ligase chain linkage types (K6, K11, K27, K29, branched)
name: E3 ligase polyubiquitin chain types and proteasomal targeting
rationale: Members describe E3 ubiquitination with diverse chain linkages and regulation of proteasomal degradation, distinguishing it from confusables focused on DUB families, E1/E2 activation, degron rules or ERAD.

qualifier: Th17 axis plus IL-1-family and IL-10-family cytokines
name: Th17-axis, IL-1-family and IL-10-family interleukin signaling
rationale: Members are IL-12/23/17, IL-33/36/38 and IL-10/IL-20 family signaling and IL-17 regulation, while confusables add type III interferon, IL-27/35 or C-type lectin antifungal signaling.

qualifier: stalled ribosome rescue, nonsense/no-go/non-stop decay
name: Translation termination, stalled-ribosome rescue and NMD mRNA surveillance
rationale: Members cover termination, ribosome rescue and RQC, and NMD/no-go decay, unlike confusables on polyadenylation, translation initiation/elongation modification or nuclear exosome decay.

qualifier: dopaminergic neurons and cerebellar granule/Bergmann glia
name: Midbrain dopaminergic and cerebellar granule neuron development
rationale: Members are midbrain dopaminergic/substantia nigra development and monoaminergic axon guidance plus cerebellar granule layer and Bergmann glia, whereas confusables concern forebrain progenitors, gliogenesis or spinal cord patterning.

qualifier: internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation control
name: Regulation of receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members regulate receptor internalization, recycling, caveolar/clathrin endocytosis and lysosomal targeting, lacking the lipoprotein clearance and endosome maturation members of the confusables.

qualifier: P4-ATPase aminophospholipid flippase
name: Aminophospholipid flippase translocation across membrane bilayers
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid translocation, its regulation and flippase-centred trafficking modules, unlike confusables on ER-Golgi lipid transfer, bile ABC transporters or calcium-activated scrambling.

qualifier: TRAIL/FasL death receptors via caspase-8 and BID
name: TRAIL and FasL death-receptor caspase-8 apoptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL/Fas signaling, procaspase-8 dimerization, c-FLIP control and BID activation including T cell activation-induced death, whereas confusables add necroptosis and negative regulation.

qualifier: neuron versus astrocyte/oligodendrocyte differentiation
name: Neuron versus astrocyte/oligodendrocyte fate decisions in CNS progenitors
rationale: Members regulate neuroblast proliferation, neuron differentiation and astrocyte/oligodendrocyte/Bergmann glia fate, while confusables concern Schwann cells and myelination, forebrain/retina patterning or radial glia division.

qualifier: chylomicron/VLDL and LDL remodeling and receptor uptake
name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein and LDL remodeling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodeling, lipase complexes and receptor internalization for clearance, whereas confusables add HDL, cholesterol efflux, ABC transporters and SREBP sterol homeostasis.

qualifier: epidermal wound repair and epithelial adhesion
name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and epidermal wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis with epithelial adhesion and wound healing, unlike confusables on hair follicle/melanocyte, keratinocyte migration or cornification.

qualifier: segmentation clock and posterior axis elongation
name: Somitogenesis, segmentation clock and posterior axis elongation
rationale: Members are somite specification, rostrocaudal patterning, LFNG segmentation and tail/axis elongation, distinguishing it from confusables on limbs, Notch O-glycosylation, neural plate or Hox clusters.

qualifier: DAG/MAG endocannabinoid signaling, glycerol transport and polyols
name: Glycerol and acylglycerol metabolism with endocannabinoid lipid signaling
rationale: Members cover glycerol/glycerol-3-phosphate, PA, DAG and MAG metabolism, endocannabinoids, aquaglyceroporin transport and polyol/fructose, lacking the phospholipid synthesis, acyl remodeling and lipolysis regulation of confusables.

qualifier: nucleoside phosphate kinases and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis
name: Deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and nucleoside phosphate kinase interconversion
rationale: Members are mono/di/triphosphate interconversion, dNTP synthesis and pyrimidine salvage, distinguishing it from confusables on de novo synthesis and nucleotide catabolism.

qualifier: Emi1 inhibition and its SCF-betaTrCP degradation
name: APC/C restraint by Emi1 and its SCF-betaTrCP degradation
rationale: Members concern inhibition of APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity via Emi1 and its phosphorylation-triggered removal at mitotic transitions, whereas confusables list APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation and activation.

qualifier: MHC class I/II induction and T cell antigen presentation
name: Interferon-gamma signaling and MHC class I/II induction
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signaling and its regulation with MHC class I/II expression and CD8 T cell responses, unlike confusables centred on Th1 differentiation, IL-12 and dendritic cell cytokines.

qualifier: stalled-ribosome nascent chains and N/C-degron rules
name: Ribosome-associated quality control and N/C-degron ubiquitin degradation
rationale: Members are RQC/RQT ribosome-associated degradation and N-end/C-end degron pathways, lacking the mRNA decay and termination, stress granule, or general proteasome regulation members of confusables.
